title: Fiscal decentralisation to local bodies
quote: Property tax = single most important own-source revenue of urban local bodies

boxes.title: Articles on local finance
head: Article
Body
Provision
rows: State Legislature ==**may**== authorise taxes, tolls, fees; grants
SFC under 243I also reviews municipal finances
Central FC augments State fund, on SFC basis

boxes.title: Revenue sources
head: Body
Sources
rows: ==**Property tax**== (most important), professional, advertisement, entertainment tax
Grants, SFC devolution, loans; municipal bonds in a few large cities
State-authorised taxes: **tax on local fairs**, house tax, tolls
FC grants, **Central Cooperative Banks**, CSS, SFC allocations

boxes.title: Grant size & conditions
items: Rural **₹4.35 lakh crore**, urban **₹3.56 lakh crore**; urban share **36% → 45%**
Conditions: **elected bodies**, audited accounts online, timely **SFCs**

boxes.title: Issues & AP
items: IGTs ≈ **40%** of ULB revenue (IIHS, 80 ULBs); India **0.5% of GDP** vs global **2-5%**
SFCs not constituted regularly; gram sabhas spend only **4%** time on revenue
AP ULB terms ended **15 March 2026**, panchayats **4 April 2026** → ==**Special Officers**==; grants at risk

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: **ES 2016-17**: property tax of ==**Bengaluru**, Jaipur via satellite imagery== (APPSC-G1 2017)
Sales tax, land revenue = State levies, not panchayat (UPPSC 2018)
